scope: Read-only native code and public pages audit. No builds, simulator runs, backend calls, ASC mutations or deployments. Local code may include unreleased changes.

source_locations.marketing_discovery_result: Verified original Angular marketing repository, own S3/CloudFront deploy script; do not migrate into arte-soft-sites.

facts.claim: Built for iPhone and iPad; public listing requires iOS/iPadOS 18.0 or later.
sources: /Users/minchomilev/work/hrapp/Cloud Calendars for Google, Microsoft and iCloud.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj:581
facts.qualification: Project disables Mac Catalyst and Mac-designed-for-iPad support. No evidence for Android, Windows, native Mac or a browser calendar client.

facts.claim: Day, multi-day/week, month, year, list and multi-calendar views are in Base.
Google Calendar synchronization and Google Meet support are Base features.
facts.qualification: Avoid asserting every event automatically receives a meeting link. Account connection and provider permissions apply.

facts.claim: Advanced includes Base features and removes ads.
facts.qualification: No inspected tier evidence for paid-exclusive cross-calendar management, Google sharing, Meet generation or priority weather refresh.

facts.claim: Premium includes Advanced and adds Microsoft Calendar and Microsoft Teams support.
facts.qualification: Do not generalize to every Exchange deployment or enterprise policy without testing.

facts.claim: App-local calendars and events can be saved on the device.
facts.qualification: Local calendars are not the same as iCloud calendars. Sharing/sync code exists separately; avoid promising local data never leaves the device under every feature.

facts.claim: The native app uses Apple WeatherKit for forecasts and supports weather planning views.
facts.qualification: Website Open-Meteo attribution does not establish the native app weather provider. Avoid 14-day forecast guarantee; local code contains a ten-day solar forecast projection.

facts.claim: Weather code models temperature, precipitation, UV, wind/gusts, humidity, visibility and moon information; detailed pressure and solar views also exist.
facts.qualification: Forecast availability is provider/location dependent. Do not promise precise forecasting or always-up-to-date widgets.

facts.claim: Home Screen widgets support small, medium and large families.
A Live Activity implementation exists for upcoming calendar events.
facts.qualification: Dynamic Island availability depends on device. Do not imply a continuously live calendar sync guarantee.

facts.claim: Event sharing, QR scanning, email invitation, App Clip import and calendar-sharing implementations exist.
facts.qualification: Source inspected only; cross-provider permissions, recipient edit rights and propagation latency have not been runtime verified.

facts.claim: Basic local use does not require a Cloud Calendars identity, but sharing invokes account sign-in.
facts.qualification: Cloud sharing identity is separate from connected Google/Microsoft calendar data-source accounts. Apple, Google and Microsoft sign-in code exists. Never say no account is required for every feature.

facts.claim: Sharing uses a Cloud Calendars API; event models include notes, location, recurrence and attendee information.
facts.qualification: Do not say all data always remains on-device, no servers, no data collection, end-to-end encryption or zero tracking. None of those blanket claims is established by this audit.

facts.claim: Travel reminder policy and notification manager are implemented.
facts.qualification: Do not market automatic routing accuracy or guaranteed timely delivery without focused runtime verification.

public_listing_snapshot.qualification: Public retrieved page, not authenticated ASC or runtime purchase test. Prices, availability, size and ratings can change; preferably omit volatile figures from evergreen articles.

purchase_copy.safe: Free download with optional auto-renewing in-app subscriptions; check current local prices in the App Store or app.
avoid: Subscription needed for Google Calendar or multi-calendar view

privacy_discrepancies.finding: App Store developer declaration says Data Not Collected; privacy policy describes potential account/access-token, usage, device and location handling. These are not equivalent statements. Escalate for privacy review, do not silently rewrite legal declarations.
Broad site on-device/no-account messaging omits authenticated server-backed sharing.

website_corrections.recommendation: Omit volatile figures or update from verified release data; existing homepage shows 1.7.0, 4.4/8 and 35.4 MB.
Describe Advanced as ad-free Base; Premium adds Microsoft and Teams. Do not gate Google or multi-calendar functionality.

website_corrections.issue: Free Meet support conflicts with Advanced automatic-Meet wording
website_corrections.recommendation: Use Google Meet support in Base and avoid unverified always-automatic generation wording.
Say start with local calendars without an account; connecting providers and sharing have authentication requirements.

website_corrections.issue: Site weather demo can imply 14-day native forecast
website_corrections.recommendation: Keep demo clearly labeled and avoid extending website demo behavior into app claims.

writer_rules: Use fact sources for each product assertion; code presence is not a runtime test or proof a feature is in the current public release.
Do not invent AI scheduling, task management, booking pages, team dashboards, availability polls, Android/web client, automatic conflict resolution, unlimited accounts or offline cloud sync.
For sharing comparisons, distinguish viewing multiple provider calendars from transferring ownership, write access and cross-provider sharing.
Prefer cautious provider support wording over all calendars or universal two-way syncing.
Keep exact prices, ratings, file size and release version out of evergreen article prose unless date-qualified.
